name: Back in Stock + Price Drop
goal: Tell shoppers the moment an item they wanted is available again or costs less, and help them order the right size with confidence.
trigger: Branch A: Subscribed to Back in Stock (Klaviyo catalog back-in-stock; messages go out when Klaviyo sees the item restocked). Branch B: Klaviyo Price Drop trigger on an item the profile viewed or added to cart in the last 30 days (requires catalog sync with prices).
flow_filters: BIS-E1A and BIS-S1A: no priority suppression beyond consent, because the shopper asked for this alert
BIS-E2A: Placed Order zero times since starting this flow; not currently in the Cart or Post-Purchase flows

Branch B: Placed Order zero times since starting; not currently in the Post-Purchase, Cart, Sample-to-Order or Depot Dollars flows (all outrank Back in Stock); has not been in branch B in the last 7 days
Can receive email marketing; SMS steps also require SMS consent
exit_conditions: Unsubscribes from email (email steps stop) or replies STOP (SMS steps stop)
smart_sending: BIS-E1A and BIS-S1A: Smart Sending OFF, because the shopper asked for this alert and it should arrive when the item is back (SMS still waits for quiet hours, 10am-8pm local). Everything else: email ON (16h), SMS ON (24h).

branches.label: Back in stock
branches.rule: Subscribed to Back in Stock for an item; sends when the Klaviyo catalog shows inventory above the restock threshold.

branches.label: Price drop
branches.rule: Catalog price drops (by at least the agreed minimum) on an item the profile viewed or added to cart in the last 30 days.

kpis.metric: Branch A placed order rate (per recipient)
Branch B placed order rate (per recipient)

build_notes: Build as two Klaviyo flows that share the BIS code and reporting tag: 'BIS-A Back in Stock' (trigger: Subscribed to Back in Stock) and 'BIS-B Price Drop' (trigger: Price Drop).

Branch A needs: a Klaviyo catalog synced from Miva with inventory quantity; the Klaviyo back-in-stock form on out-of-stock product pages (email, plus optional SMS opt-in with the compliant disclosure from the SMS program doc); and back-in-stock settings (restock threshold, batch size) agreed with operations so alerts don't oversell what came in.

Made-to-order items are built to order and rarely show as out of stock, so branch A is mostly in-stock lines. Branch B can include made-to-order items, so BIS-E1B carries the made-to-order line as a show/hide bullet (show when is_made_to_order = true).

Branch B: Klaviyo Price Drop with a 30-day lookback on Viewed Product and Added to Cart. Agree a minimum drop with the business so tiny changes don't fire. Only real, standing catalog prices; QA the feed so a pricing error never triggers a send.
BIS-E1B shows previous and new prices exactly as the catalog supplies them. Do not compute or show a percent-off badge (made-to-order discount guardrail).

BIS-S1B goes only to profiles who added the item to cart: split on the Price Drop trigger's source event if Klaviyo exposes it; otherwise approximate with 'Added to Cart at least once in the last 30 days'.
BIS-E2A: skip it if the item is out of stock again at send time (catalog inventory check). If that can't be automated, the similar-pieces block keeps the email useful.
SMS: quiet hours 10am-8pm local; BIS-S1A waits for the next window if a restock lands overnight.
